say:1:1131030001:1.text: Yeah, time went by so terribly slow in that tunnel.
say:1:1131030001:1.source_cn: 是啊，在隧道里的日子真是漫长得可怕。
say:1:1131030001:1.male: Yeah, time went by so terribly slow in that tunnel.
say:1:1131030001:1.female: Yeah, time went by so terribly slow in that tunnel.

say:2:1131030002:1.text: It was narrow and dark without sunlight. I only figured out how long I'd been down there once I got home.
say:2:1131030002:1.source_cn: 那里又狭小又昏暗，还见不到太阳，连我在那里干了多少天苦...
say:2:1131030002:1.male: It was narrow and dark without sunlight. I only figured out how long I'd been down there once I got home.
say:2:1131030002:1.female: It was narrow and dark without sunlight. I only figured out how long I'd been down there once I got home.

say:3:1131030003:1.text: Home, sweet home! I can't wait for some hot stew!
say:3:1131030003:1.source_cn: 还是家里好！又能吃到新鲜的肉排汤了！
say:3:1131030003:1.male: Home, sweet home! I can't wait for some hot stew!
say:3:1131030003:1.female: Home, sweet home! I can't wait for some hot stew!
